description: Deterministic 60 Hz Archer L reproduction; 96 Katja action cases, 336 standing roster controls and 8 precisely timed defensive cases.
limitations: Fixed input schedules are collision regression cases, not player win-rate estimates. Jump/dash do not promise immunity after landing or after the six-frame dash window. There is no gameplay crouch state; heavy is Katja's visually kneeling Q pose.
